n27ddf1f2e1.headline: Bangladesh: Amidst rising persecution of minorities, Mohd Yunus govt seeks 50,000 tonnes of rice from India
n27ddf1f2e1.summary: Bangladesh has urgently turned to India to procure 50,000 tonnes of rice at a discounted price amid a critical depletion of food reserves and soaring inflation.
n27ddf1f2e1.why: Bangladesh is a large rice importer, so food reserve levels and procurement prices affect domestic inflation and the government's budget.

nbe8d862184.headline: Takaful Emarat announces successful capital increase, reaching Dh210 million
nbe8d862184.summary: Takaful Emarat announced a successful capital increase, bringing its capital to Dh210 million. The company said the move reflects shareholder confidence.
nbe8d862184.why: Takaful Emarat is a UAE Islamic insurance operator, and capital increases strengthen its ability to underwrite business and meet regulatory requirements.

nc8d9f4cdd5.headline: Bank of Greece: Greece's growth rate is expected to reach 2.5% in 2025
nc8d9f4cdd5.summary: Based on current forecasts, Greek GDP growth is expected to reach 2.3% in 2024 and accelerate to 2.5% in 2025. Growth is then projected to slip to 2.3% in 2026.
nc8d9f4cdd5.why: The Bank of Greece is the country's central bank, and its growth forecasts inform investor assessments of Greek fiscal space, bond spreads and banking-sector prospects.

n3ce1063a9a.headline: VAT Hike Expected To Boost Nigeria’s Revenue-to-GDP Ratio To 10.3%
n3ce1063a9a.summary: A value-added tax increase in Nigeria is expected to raise the revenue-to-GDP ratio to 10.3%. The projection concerns government revenue collection relative to economic output.
n3ce1063a9a.why: Tax reforms shape government revenue, fiscal sustainability and sovereign credit assessments, which matter for investors in Nigerian debt and consumer-facing businesses.

nda7caacdba.headline: Tanzania’s hydropower project reaches 99.55pc completion
nda7caacdba.summary: Five turbines are fully operational and together average 1,175 megawatts to the national grid, according to the TANESCO chief. The project is nearing completion.
nda7caacdba.why: Hydropower supplies a large share of electricity in many African economies, so new generating capacity affects grid reliability, power costs and industrial output.

n678afd5dd2.headline: FCT-IRS Generates N252.83 Billion In Internal Revenue In 2024
n678afd5dd2.summary: The Federal Capital Territory Internal Revenue Service reported N252.83 billion in internal revenue for 2024. The report was published by The News Chronicle.
n678afd5dd2.why: The FCT Internal Revenue Service collects tax revenue in Abuja, the Nigerian capital. Its collections indicate the fiscal capacity of the territory's government.

nf5ff27a65d.headline: Rising butter prices give European consumers and bakers a bad taste
nf5ff27a65d.summary: Butter prices are soaring across Europe, hitting consumers and businesses. A global milk shortage, linked to declining production and the war in Ukraine, is driving the increase.
nf5ff27a65d.why: Butter is a dairy commodity whose prices reflect global milk supply, feed costs and trade flows. Higher dairy input costs squeeze bakeries, food makers and retail margins.

n05c4dc007c.headline: China Huaneng secures $2.1 billion equity boost for renewables expansion
n05c4dc007c.summary: China Huaneng Group obtained CNY 15 billion ($2.1 billion) in equity financing for its renewables subsidiary from five state-owned entities. The deal is the largest renewable equity financing of 2024.
n05c4dc007c.why: China Huaneng is a major state-owned power generator, and equity injections into its renewables arm fund wind and solar expansion. Such deals reduce the subsidiary's financial pressure.

n197f9dbfe7.headline: Ghana slowly retracing steps back to path of macroeconomic stability - Deloitte
n197f9dbfe7.summary: Deloitte said Ghana is gradually returning to the path of macroeconomic stability. The firm also listed some downside risks to the projected economic growth.
n197f9dbfe7.why: Deloitte is a major professional services firm whose macroeconomic assessments inform investor views on frontier markets. Stability and growth risks shape sovereign and investment outlooks.

ncb3a2fda6c.headline: How Deep Will Crypto Dive?
ncb3a2fda6c.summary: The crypto market lost 4.4% in the last 24 hours to $3.36 trillion, more than 11% below its all-time peak of $3.79 trillion. Cryptocurrencies kept falling even as stock market sell-offs slowed.
ncb3a2fda6c.why: Bitcoin and other crypto assets are traded globally and their total market value is tracked as a gauge of risk appetite. Sharp moves can spill into related crypto-exposed equities.

impacts.name: Crypto market
impacts.why: Total crypto market value fell 4.4% in 24 hours and is over 11% below its all-time peak.

ncb3a2fda6c.why_moved: Cryptocurrencies continued to decline while stock market sell-offs slowed, according to the report. The total market value fell sharply from the recent peak.

nb50fdc6a4d.headline: Rupee Ends in Red Against US Dollar for Fourth Time This Week
nb50fdc6a4d.summary: The Pakistani rupee ended the week lower against the US dollar on Friday, its fourth session of depreciation this week.
nb50fdc6a4d.why: The rupee's value against the dollar affects Pakistan's import costs and external debt servicing. Pakistan relies on dollar funding for energy and other imports.

impacts.name: Pakistani rupee
impacts.why: The rupee depreciated against the US dollar in four sessions during the week.

ncb2f836bcf.headline: Allgeier SE:  Guidance for the 2025 financial year and mid-term expectation
ncb2f836bcf.summary: Allgeier SE published an ad hoc disclosure of inside information containing its guidance for the 2025 financial year and its mid-term expectations.
ncb2f836bcf.why: Allgeier is a German IT services and engineering group, and ad hoc guidance is a regulated signal of its expected earnings.

n1190a30465.headline: Gold Prices Rebound but Remain Set for Weekly Decline Amid Fed Outlook and Inflation Concerns
n1190a30465.summary: Gold prices rebounded but remained on course for a weekly decline after the Federal Reserve's meeting. The Fed's 25-basis-point cut matched expectations, but its cautious 2025 outlook weighed on gold.
n1190a30465.why: Gold is a traditional store of value that tends to be sensitive to real interest rates and the dollar. Expectations for Fed policy influence its price.
n1190a30465.why_moved: The Fed's 25-basis-point cut was in line with expectations, but its more cautious 2025 rate outlook put downward pressure on gold. Prices rebounded later but stayed on track for a weekly decline.

n083029f401.headline: 24 hours after presentation, Senate, Reps pass N49.7trn 2025 budget for second reading
n083029f401.summary: Within 24 hours of President Bola Tinubu presenting the N49.7 trillion 2025 budget to a joint session, the Senate and House of Representatives moved it to second reading.
n083029f401.why: The federal budget sets government spending and revenue plans for Africa's largest economy, affecting fiscal policy, borrowing needs and investor confidence in Nigerian assets.

n7ea3913de5.headline: The liquidity crisis in Nigerian banks
n7ea3913de5.summary: Nigerian bank customers are facing difficulties accessing cash at branches, highlighting a liquidity problem in a banking system long seen as the backbone of the economy.
n7ea3913de5.why: Liquidity shortages at banks can disrupt payments, lending and depositor confidence, affecting the broader financial system.

n8e0f9b8912.headline: Like in Senate, 2025 Budget Bill scales second reading in House of Representatives
n8e0f9b8912.summary: Nigeria's House of Representatives has passed the N49.7 trillion 2025 Appropriation Bill for second reading. The bill follows a similar step in the Senate.
n8e0f9b8912.why: The federal budget sets government spending and borrowing plans, which shape fiscal policy, bond issuance and the outlook for Africa's largest economy by population.

n29dcddfaf5.headline: FNPF’s net return on investment increases to 8.5% resulting in 8% interest payout to members in July
n29dcddfaf5.summary: The Fiji National Provident Fund reported a net return on investment of 8.5% for the financial year ended 30 June 2024. Assets grew to $10.6 billion from $9.5 billion, and an 8% interest payout is planned for members in July.
n29dcddfaf5.why: The Fiji National Provident Fund is the country's main pension fund, so its investment returns affect retirement savings and the domestic capital market.

n5bf8c7805f.headline: Retail sales inch higher as consumer weakness weighs
n5bf8c7805f.summary: The volume of goods bought across Great Britain increased by 0.2% in the four weeks to 23 November, according to the Office for National Statistics. The report describes weak consumer demand.
n5bf8c7805f.why: Retail sales data from the Office for National Statistics is a key gauge of consumer spending, which drives a large share of UK GDP and retailer earnings.

n1b6ecf6d2c.headline: More student loans canceled by Biden admin before leaving office
n1b6ecf6d2c.summary: The Biden administration is canceling federal student loans for another 55,000 public service workers through an existing forgiveness program. The move comes before the administration leaves office.
n1b6ecf6d2c.why: Federal student loan policy affects the size of the public debt portfolio and household finances, and it shapes the outlook for the education lending sector.

n6ac120de05.headline: Biden-Harris admin rolls out another $4.28 billion in student loan handouts
n6ac120de05.summary: As the Biden administration enters its final days, it has announced $4.28 billion in student loan relief for nearly 54,900 public workers.
n6ac120de05.why: Federal student loan policy affects the federal budget, loan servicers and household finances, and changes in administration can alter these programmes.

nd88fb363b7.headline: Why Viking Therapeutics Tumbled by More Than 10% This Week
nd88fb363b7.summary: Viking Therapeutics shares tumbled by more than 10% this week, according to a Motley Fool report on the stock's move.
nd88fb363b7.why: Viking Therapeutics is a San Diego-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, so its share price reflects trial progress and investor sentiment about its drug pipeline.

n9cbbd3c197.headline: 'President Musk told Republicans not to ... ': Rosa DeLauro slams Elon for stalling Spending Bill
n9cbbd3c197.summary: Representative Rosa DeLauro criticised Elon Musk's influence over Republicans, linking it to a potential government shutdown. The spending bill is the focus of the dispute.
n9cbbd3c197.why: A US government shutdown halts federal services and can delay data releases and spending. Political wrangling over spending bills influences Treasury issuance and market risk sentiment.

nbc4fa2d8d6.headline: Hurdles in materialization of GCC’s economic ventures in Pakistan
nbc4fa2d8d6.summary: Pakistan must boost economic productivity to strengthen trade ties with Gulf Cooperation Council countries and secure sustainable growth. The article highlights hurdles to GCC investment ventures.
nbc4fa2d8d6.why: The GCC is a major source of investment and energy financing for Pakistan, which relies on Gulf partners during balance-of-payments pressure.

n736f75719f.headline: Australia’s Macquarie Real Estate invests in local private credit manager IDA
n736f75719f.summary: Macquarie Real Estate has invested in IDA, a local private credit manager. Macquarie says IDA benefits from growing demand for property financing as banks reduce lending to the sector.
n736f75719f.why: Macquarie Group is a global investment bank and asset manager, and private credit has grown as banks pull back from commercial property lending.

n03bac0563b.headline: Indian Stock Markets Plummet as Investors Brace for Economic Challenges Ahead | Business
n03bac0563b.summary: Sensex and Nifty each shed over 1.5% in a week-ending sell-off led by heavy selling in IT and banking shares. Concerns over US Federal Reserve rate plans and rising trade deficits weighed on sentiment.
n03bac0563b.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmark indices of India's stock market, which tracks the country's largest listed companies. Their moves reflect foreign and domestic investor sentiment toward India.
n03bac0563b.why_moved: Heavy selling in IT and banking shares drove the decline. Investors cited concerns over US Federal Reserve rate plans and rising trade deficits.

n26315eef6c.headline: Scholz calls for European purchase incentives for e-cars
n26315eef6c.summary: German Chancellor Olaf Scholz called for a European e-car requirement and demand measures such as purchase incentives after an EU summit in Brussels.
n26315eef6c.why: Electric car demand depends on purchase incentives and regulation, which shape the outlook for automakers and charging and battery supply chains in Europe.

n9403bf5662.headline: Thailand expects cash flow of $2bn from tax break plan
n9403bf5662.summary: Thailand expects cash flow of 70 billion baht (US$2.02 billion) from a planned tax break due next month, a deputy finance minister said. The measure aims to help boost the economy.
n9403bf5662.why: Tax measures are a key fiscal tool, and their size and timing affect growth expectations for investors in Thai assets.

na20a10bc22.headline: Pakistan terms United States sanctions on its commercial entities as ‘unfortunate and biased’
na20a10bc22.summary: Pakistan called the latest US sanctions on its commercial entities unfortunate and biased, citing double standards and discriminatory practices. The government in Islamabad issued the response on Thursday.
na20a10bc22.why: US sanctions on foreign companies can restrict access to dollar payments and trade, affecting investor sentiment toward affected economies.

n9415ab4885.headline: SMALL CAP MOVERS: Technology Minerals boosted by Glencore deal
n9415ab4885.summary: Technology Minerals gained before Christmas on a deal between its subsidiary Recyclus and Glencore. Details of the deal were not included in the report.
n9415ab4885.why: Glencore is a global diversified mining and commodity trading company, and deals with it can signal demand for minerals and recycling services.

n051215e2b1.headline: One last hurdle remains for the year
n051215e2b1.summary: Several central banks have concluded their final policy meetings of 2024, with some holding rates steady. The day-ahead preview covers European and global markets.
n051215e2b1.why: Central bank policy meetings set interest rates that influence bond yields, currencies and equity valuations worldwide.

na6f969aa99.headline: Key Supreme Court ruling comes in case involving capping of charges on late credit card bill payment
na6f969aa99.summary: A key Supreme Court ruling is pending in a case concerning caps on charges for late credit card bill payments. The national consumer court had in 2010 restrained banks from charging interest above 30% a year.
na6f969aa99.why: Credit card interest rules directly affect the revenue of Indian banks and lenders, and they are set by courts and regulators.

n2356c07ffc.headline: OUE Reit divests entire stake in Shanghai office property for 1.9 billion yuan
n2356c07ffc.summary: OUE REIT has divested its entire stake in a Shanghai office property for 1.9 billion yuan. The transaction is expected to yield net proceeds of about S$318.2 million.
n2356c07ffc.why: OUE REIT is a Singapore-listed real estate investment trust, and asset disposals affect its distributions and portfolio composition.

n62c6935dfc.headline: Cooking Oil, Ghee prices move up by Rs100 in Pakistan; Check new rates here
n62c6935dfc.summary: Prices of leading cooking oil and ghee brands in Pakistan rose by Rs100 in a week, adding to a slight surge in inflation. The increase makes cooking more expensive.
n62c6935dfc.why: Food prices are a major component of inflation, which influences central bank policy and household spending power in Pakistan.

n086fa8af6d.headline: Carnival Corporation & Plc Q4 Earnings Summary
n086fa8af6d.summary: Carnival reported fourth-quarter earnings of $303 million, compared with a loss of $48 million in the same period a year earlier.
n086fa8af6d.why: Carnival is one of the world's largest cruise operators, so its results reflect demand and cost trends across the leisure travel sector.

n7f8bf243a4.headline: CoinDesk ownership Bullish fires top editorial staff amid newsroom controversy
n7f8bf243a4.summary: CoinDesk CEO Sara Stratoberdha told editorial staff that editor-in-chief Kevin Reynolds and two deputies were let go. The move follows a newsroom controversy at the crypto news outlet owned by Bullish.
n7f8bf243a4.why: CoinDesk is a crypto news outlet owned by Bullish, a crypto exchange, so editorial decisions can bear on the credibility of its market coverage.

n9fca7012ad.headline: Korea’s NPS triples local property investments for 2025 to 2.25 trillion won, report says
n9fca7012ad.summary: South Korea's National Pension Service has raised its 2025 local property investment allocation to 2.25 trillion won, tripling it, to capitalise on an expected commercial property recovery.
n9fca7012ad.why: The National Pension Service is South Korea's state pension fund, one of the largest institutional investors in the country, so its allocation shifts can influence local real estate and capital markets.

nd40256a3fc.headline: FedEx (FDX) Q2 2025 Earnings Call Transcript
nd40256a3fc.summary: FedEx held its earnings call for the fiscal second quarter 2025, covering the period ending September 30, 2024. The source provides only a transcript listing, without financial results.
nd40256a3fc.why: FedEx is a global logistics company, and its quarterly results offer insight into parcel shipping demand and global freight trends.

n21989c7fc3.headline: October GDP to Look Marginally Stronger After Slew of Weak Data
n21989c7fc3.summary: Statistics Canada's October gross domestic product release is seen at 0.2% monthly growth, the strongest since April and above the 0.1% advance estimate. It is the last GDP print before the Bank of Canada's January 29 meeting.
n21989c7fc3.why: GDP growth data helps the Bank of Canada decide on interest rates, which affect borrowing costs and the Canadian dollar.

n5b4dc47867.headline: Can Canadian businesses actually opt-out of GST holiday?
n5b4dc47867.summary: Guidance on whether businesses across Canada can opt out of providing a GST holiday for consumers has been unclear. The holiday is intended to ease the cost of living.
n5b4dc47867.why: The goods and services tax (GST) is a federal consumption tax, and a temporary GST holiday changes retail prices and sales tax collection for businesses.

nceb5b33177.headline: In Azerbaijan, a car company sharply reduced its capital by 190 thousand manats
nceb5b33177.summary: Eco Cars Azerbaijan LLC announced a reduction of its charter capital by 190 thousand manats, according to the State Tax Service.
nceb5b33177.why: Changes in a company's charter capital can indicate restructuring or financial adjustments, relevant for investors tracking corporate developments in Azerbaijan.

n5b9749f70a.headline: Markets decline in early trade amid unabated foreign fund outflows
n5b9749f70a.summary: Indian markets declined in early trade with major laggards including Axis Bank, Tech Mahindra, IndusInd Bank, JSW Steel, ITC, Larsen & Toubro, UltraTech Cement, and HDFC Bank amid unabated foreign fund outflows.
n5b9749f70a.why: Foreign fund flows significantly impact Indian equity markets, influencing liquidity and valuations.

impacts.why: Foreign outflows pressure banking stocks including Axis Bank.

n5b9749f70a.why_moved: Foreign fund outflows reduce market liquidity and investor demand, causing declines in major Indian stocks and indices.

n2b8295fdfb.headline: Bucharest Stock Exchange opens in the green Friday's session
n2b8295fdfb.summary: The Bucharest Stock Exchange opened higher with turnover reaching 9.71 million RON (1.95 million euros) early in the session, with the main BET index appreciating.
n2b8295fdfb.why: Local market performance and turnover indicate investor sentiment and liquidity in Romania's equity market.
